WITH first_version AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT join_date, count(*) AS n_first_versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS n_members
FROM first_version WHERE version_no = 1 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-08'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'max_sale' AS k, CAST(max(sale_date) AS VARCHAR) AS v FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'max_join', CAST(max(join_date) AS VARCHAR) FROM dim_member
UNION ALL SELECT 'max_loaded', CAST(max(etl_loaded_at) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'dupe_member_ids_in_join_oct3', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
